name: laptop-screen-selfie
image_purpose: Lifestyle meta-shot and social-media realism post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical meta-shot of a MacBook Pro screen displaying a Photo Booth selfie, preserving the athletic outfit, hardwood apartment, keyboard, and raw screen-capture texture.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with athletic build and realistic soft curves, authentic skin pores and faint stretch marks, wearing a white cotton crop top with secure coverage and burgundy high-waisted ribbed athletic shorts. She sits on a hardwood floor, leans back on one arm, and holds a smartphone for the Photo Booth mirror selfie.
prompt.composition_elements: First-person view looking down at the MacBook screen, keyboard visible in the foreground, screen showing Photo Booth with the subject in a minimalist modern apartment, light hardwood floor, white walls and distant kitchen cabinetry. Vertical 4:5.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused window light on the subject, gentle realistic shadows and subtle screen glow on the keyboard, raw unedited digital noise and pixel grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro Max capture of a MacBook Pro screen, 24mm wide lens, vertical 4:5, realistic pixel grid and screen reflection, no polished studio look.
